steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in at http://127.0.0.1:8097/ with username admin and password {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} (type the password text exactly as {{env:APP_PASSWORD}}). Then go to Opportunities list view and report the names of all opportunities whose name starts with 'Seed:', exactly as shown.

02-create: Create a new Opportunity named '{{runid}} Bench Opportunity', linked to account 'Bench Account' (choose it via suggestions/dialog so it's actually linked), stage 'Negotiation', amount 12500, close date 2026-12-31, assigned to user 'Bench Assignee' (choose via suggestions), and a description that includes the text '{{runid}}'. Save it. Then open its record page and verify all these values are displayed, and report the record ID from the URL (#Opportunity/view/<id>).

03-verify: On the opportunity record page {{02-create.url}}, verify the Close Date shows year 2026 (if it displays only 'Dec 31', edit the field or check its stored value to confirm it is 2026-12-31; fix it if not). Then post on the record's Stream a post whose text includes '{{runid}}', and verify the post appears in the stream. Report the close date as finally displayed/stored and the post text.
